newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products ease - gasoline falls after NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products ease - gasoline falls after NYMEX.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mostly weaker on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline eased $1 a tonne after falling back from a mid-afternoon rally inspired by firmer NYMEX prices.
Rotterdam barges traded at $186 fob for premium unleaded and at $178.50 for regular during the morning but afternoon activity focused on swaps.
Gas oil prices were unchanged to slightly softer. Traders said tighter ARA supplies pegged barge and cargo premiums to a slightly softer benchmark gas oil futures steady.
High sulphur barges ended lower, trading at $84 and $84.75 with pressure from lower swaps and some pressured cargoes. Low sulphur barges were quiet but sellers and buyers moved closer to $96/$96.50.
High sulphur cargoes were largely steady but two cargoes of lower quality material still have not found buyers and were said to be pressured by incoming Russian material.
